source.producer_literal_description:
Extract only the latest user message, never earlier consent. Current phase: {{phase}}. Exact tagged-row grammar: k=KIND;c=0_OR_1;[optional key=value;]END. Rows separated by a single newline. No quotes, JSON, empty fields, extra separators or trailing newline. Required k and c. c=0 for unfinished answers or corrections, c=1 only complete. For unfinished payment/proposal/change/consent/hardship rows c=0, REQUIRED u=amount, date, both, or unknown: the component still unfinished, independently of any complete sibling. a and d contain ONLY completed components. u=unknown if unclear which changed. A complete date beside an unfinished amount requires u=amount; Mon... requires u=date. Complete rows c=1 omit u. Optional p=exact product ID or spoken type/label; a=plain positive decimal amount; d=verbatim exact date phrase (today, tomorrow, this/next weekday, YYYY-MM-DD, DD/MM/YYYY, day month year); v=security answer (DOB verbatim date, phone exactly four digits); t=HH:MM. Values may contain only letters, numbers, spaces, underscore, period, slash, colon, hyphen. No escaping: if a value needs a delimiter, emit k=unknown;c=1;END. Unknown/duplicate keys forbidden. Kinds: agree callback change confirm deceased decline dispute hardship human paid plan proposal purpose question recipient refuse security stop third_party too_much unknown vague wrong_number. Recipient only explicit yes/thats me/speaking/own name; greeting is unknown. Security v must preserve numeric DOB as day/month/year. Proposal a/d only positive asserted payment terms, never negated or incidental dates. Partial amount/date retains its target. Agreement to an actual spoken offer is agree; clear unqualified yes after readback is confirm. Qualified yes with new terms is proposal; incomplete correction c=0. paid means current arrears already paid, historical closed/paid off is dispute; negated claims do not count. Hardship outranks plans/refusal but include any voluntary a/d. Human/plan/stop outrank incidental keywords. One row per distinct target; collective yes can use one unscoped agree/confirm only when it clearly covers all spoken offers/readback. Examples (literal valid outputs):
k=recipient;c=1;END
k=security;c=1;v=14 October 1980;END
k=security;c=1;v=1234;END
k=proposal;c=1;p=credit card;a=120;d=next Friday;END
k=agree;c=1;p=personal loan;END
k=confirm;c=1;END
k=proposal;c=0;p=car loan;u=date;a=50;END
k=callback;c=1;d=tomorrow;t=15:00;END
k=proposal;c=1;p=credit card;a=120;d=next Friday;END
k=refuse;c=1;p=personal loan;END
k=paid;c=1;p=car loan;END ALWAYS emit a nonempty event for every latest reply. A bare complete four-digit reply in phone phase is security with v, never omit it. A complete birth date in dob phase is security with v. Every security event requires v. Incomplete date corrections use k=change;c=0 and d only if a complete date was spoken. One proposal plus too_much for the same product is allowed; do not put the rejected full amount into the proposal. Simple yes in readback phase is k=confirm;c=1;END, and yes in offer phase is k=agree;c=1;END. Never extract prior speech.
Unfinished examples (literal valid outputs):
k=change;c=0;u=date;END
k=proposal;c=0;u=amount;d=this Friday;END
k=change;c=0;u=amount;END
k=change;c=0;u=unknown;END
Only a newly complete explicit customer amount resolves u=amount; a later date-only answer leaves it unresolved. Never reuse an earlier superseded amount.
A both/unknown correction may be completed over multiple turns: emit only each latest explicit completed component, for example k=proposal;c=1;a=120;END then k=proposal;c=1;d=next Friday;END, or the reverse order. Never repeat cached facts as newly spoken facts. Literal both correction: k=change;c=0;u=both;END.
Primary intent and independent questions: emit ONE primary row plus admin flags, not question rows. Husband/wife/relative plus purpose or payment offer is third_party, never recipient/security. Security with a complete answer plus a question remains security with v. Lower instalments/new plan is plan, never an incomplete amount. In support phase refusal plus discount question is decline. AI/robot question alone is question with admin=ai, never human. A complete spoken date uses d verbatim; accept yearless month/ordinal expressions, weekday plus day ordinal and ordinary punctuation. On agree with a new explicit date ALWAYS include d; never reuse old offer date. Vague periods use vague, not unfinished amount. Examples: k=third_party;c=1;END (admin=purpose); k=security;c=1;v=21 July 1990;END (admin=purpose); k=proposal;c=1;d=the sixth of November;END (admin=ai); k=decline;c=1;END (support decline plus discount question); k=plan;c=1;END (lower instalments); k=agree;c=1;d=this Friday;END; k=proposal;c=1;d=Monday the twenty sixth;END. c=0 only genuinely unfinished speech, never a complete refusal, hardship or restructuring request.

method.authoring_assumptions: Inputs authored to exact current row grammar, one primary row plus admin=purpose. No extractor model execution or evidence that hosted producer emits these rows. audit_conclusion: Nine of eleven authored scenario observations match. Mixedintent fixes and both amount-cache guards qualify locally. Impossible/conflicting dates reject at parse but repeated invalid date assertions trigger deadline counteroffer, so strict remain-rejected behavior is not qualified. No hosted, extractor, ASR or hidden-test claims.
parent_policy_qualification: The two strict remain-unresolved design controls remain mismatches, with original observations/expectations preserved. Brief A does not explicitly define repeated impossible/contradictory date handling; offering a valid policy deadline with later fresh confirmation is not itself proof of an official policy breach. No invalid-date acceptance or promise write was observed. Treat as clarification/fallback design issue requiring policy-qualified review, not a demonstrated consent bypass.
